open_obligations.what_is_open: Uniform Hadamard directional differentiability and uniform consistency of the estimated frontier derivative through zero perspective cells, nonunique optimizers, and moving odds faces, together with an adaptive exact inversion at the extended-real boundary.
open_obligations.obstruction: The frozen regularity assumptions supply a uniform Slater margin only on the named regular region. Outside it, they give neither a facial metric-regularity modulus nor an active-set separation condition, so optimizer correspondences and tangent cones can change discontinuously; the boundary pair also proves that no uniformly honest finite-width continuation can cover the finite-to-infinite transition.
open_obligations.attempted: Linearized the margin and ATE equations on fixed optimizer faces, retained the closed perspective recession term on zero cells, and enlarged active odds sets. This closes pointwise fixed-face programs but gives no uniform face-identification or metric-regularity bound over the class in the open question.
